title: Blood PAXgene Hospitalized and Lethal COVID-19 relative to controls (vaccinated and unvaccinated)
description: Blood PAXgene samples with paired-end RNAseq generated with globin and ribo reduction. Groups include hospitalized COVID-19, lethal hospitalized COVID-19, unvaccinated controls, and recently vaccinated controls.
